procedure: Compiled preview, normal Workspace to Memory navigation, titles enabled. Two consecutive 600-frame rotating/zooming runs with moving-pointer picking, followed by a scheduling-only diagnostic. Other user applications stayed running. No local builds or tests ran during the measurements.
interpretation: Observed CPU p95 fell from 2.4 ms to 1.9 ms on the first optimized run and 1.2 ms on the warmed repeat. Frame p95 remains 17.6 ms, including the scheduling-only baseline, so the strict 16.7 ms requirement is still unmet. The repeat is warm and is not a controlled causal estimate. maxWorkMs is cumulative since page load, including earlier render work when the scheduler diagnostic runs. Zero long-task duration means none observed at or above 50 ms.
